Name: Animals Fertilize Crops
Author: vapor64
Description:
Farm animals now have a small chance to fertilize a crop field when walking over the crop tile. 
[u][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][/u][u][b][size=3]How It Works[/size][/b][/u]
Animals walking on your farm have a chance each second to fertilize the soil tile they are standing on and the tiles immediately surrounding them.
The fertilizer tier depends on the animal type, and higher friendship increases the chance.

[size=3][b][u]Fertilizer Tiers[/u][/b]
Basic Fertilizer→ Chickens, Ducks
Quality Fertilizer→ Cows, Goats
Deluxe Fertilizer→ Sheep, Pigs, Rabbits, Ostriches, Dinosaurs

For similar overview, FAQs and config explanation check in-game GMDF documentation.

[size=3]Please consider endorsing this mod if you find it helpful.[/size]
